steps.title: Check Eligibility
steps.description: Confirm you meet CEC requirements including Canadian work experience, language ability, and eligibility criteria.

requiredDocuments.title: Proof of Canadian work experience
requiredDocuments.description: For example, a reference or experience letter from an employer. IRCC says information from this evidence may be needed when creating an Express Entry profile.
requiredDocuments.condition: Prepare when claiming Canadian work experience; check your personalized document list before submitting an application.

officialLinks.label: IRCC: Get your Express Entry documents ready

preparationChecklist.text: Find the NOC for your Canadian job and check that it is TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3 and matches the work you performed.
Check that you have at least 1 year or 1,560 hours of qualifying paid Canadian work in the 3 years before applying, gained while authorized to work; count no more than 30 hours per week.
Review IRCC's rules on self-employment and work gained while a full-time student; check the stated physician exception if it may apply to you.
Check the language threshold for your NOC TEER group in all four abilities; an approved test is needed before creating an Express Entry profile.
Review admissibility requirements and confirm that you plan to live outside Quebec.

officialLinks.label: IRCC: Express Entry language test requirements
IRCC: Get your Express Entry documents ready

commonMistakes: Counting more than 30 hours per week toward the 1,560-hour minimum.
Counting unpaid work, self-employment, or work gained while a full-time student without checking IRCC's rules and any applicable exception.
Assuming the same language threshold applies to every NOC TEER group or using an unapproved language test.

steps.title: Take Language Test
steps.description: Complete an approved English or French language test.

requiredDocuments.title: Approved language test result
requiredDocuments.condition: Needed to complete an Express Entry profile and still valid when submitting the permanent residence application.

preparationChecklist.text: Choose an IRCC-approved English or French test and the accepted version of that test.
Compare speaking, listening, reading and writing results with the CEC minimum for your NOC TEER group.
Make sure results will be less than 2 years old when you complete your profile and submit your permanent residence application.

commonMistakes: Using a test version IRCC does not accept, or relying on results that have expired.

steps.title: Create Express Entry Profile
steps.description: Create and submit your Express Entry profile.

requiredDocuments.title: Passport or travel document
requiredDocuments.condition: Have the details available when IRCC asks for them in your profile.

requiredDocuments.title: Approved language test result
requiredDocuments.condition: Enter valid results in your Express Entry profile.

preparationChecklist.text: Gather your identity, language, education and work history information before starting the profile.
Complete and submit the profile within the time shown by IRCC after starting it.
Update the profile when your circumstances change while you are in the pool.

commonMistakes: Treating entry to the Express Entry pool as an invitation or approval for permanent residence.

steps.title: Receive Invitation to Apply
steps.description: Wait for an Invitation to Apply (ITA) from IRCC.

preparationChecklist.text: Check your IRCC account for invitations and profile messages.
Keep work history, language results and other profile details current while waiting.
Review IRCC invitation-round information; an eligible profile does not guarantee an invitation.

commonMistakes: Assuming a previous round score guarantees an invitation in a future round.

steps.title: Submit PR Application
steps.description: Submit your permanent residence application with required documents.

requiredDocuments.title: Documents on your personalized IRCC checklist
requiredDocuments.condition: The exact list appears after you complete the online application form.

requiredDocuments.title: Medical exam information sheet, form or previous exam details
requiredDocuments.condition: Follow IRCC instructions for an upfront exam or a qualifying previous exam.

preparationChecklist.text: Read the invitation in your IRCC account and confirm which program invited you.
Complete the form, collect and upload the documents shown in your personalized checklist, and provide required translations.
Check IRCC medical-exam instructions: Express Entry applicants normally complete the exam after invitation and before submitting the application.
Pay the required fees and submit the complete application within the invitation validity period shown by IRCC.

commonMistakes: Missing the invitation deadline or assuming a generic document list replaces the personalized IRCC checklist.

steps.title: Biometrics and IRCC Follow-up
steps.description: For Express Entry, the medical exam is normally completed after invitation and before the PR application is submitted. After submission, follow IRCC instructions for biometrics or any medical follow-up.

requiredDocuments.title: Biometrics instruction letter
requiredDocuments.condition: Use it if IRCC instructs you to give biometrics after your application is submitted.

preparationChecklist.text: Keep your medical exam information sheet, form or previous exam details with your application records.
If IRCC sends a biometrics instruction letter, follow its directions and deadline.
Respond if IRCC asks for additional medical information or a new exam.

commonMistakes: Waiting until after submission to arrange an upfront medical exam when IRCC requires it before applying.

steps.title: Background Check
steps.description: IRCC reviews security and background information.

preparationChecklist.text: Monitor your IRCC account for status changes and requests for more information.
Tell IRCC about material changes, such as a new address or a change in family composition, using its instructions.

commonMistakes: Ignoring a request for more information or failing to report a material change after submission.

steps.title: PR Decision

requiredDocuments.title: Confirmation of Permanent Residence
requiredDocuments.condition: Issued if IRCC approves the application; follow instructions for your location.

officialLinks.label: IRCC: If we approve your application

preparationChecklist.text: Check your IRCC account for the decision and follow the instructions provided.
If approved, verify that the details on your confirmation of permanent residence are correct.
Follow the applicable IRCC steps for confirming permanent residence inside or outside Canada.

officialLinks.label: IRCC: If we approve your application

commonMistakes: Treating an approval message as completion of every confirmation step; follow IRCC instructions for your location.
